name: Directory Web Promotion

sources.title: Directory Web Promotion - Submit Link (Step One: Choose a Category)
Directory Web Promotion homepage - business-focused web directory with articles

requirements: Legacy phpLD-style directory: 'Submit Link' starts with 'Step One: Choose a Category' from a very large topical tree (Automobile Parts, Blogs and Diaries, Business & Economy, Computers & Internet, ...)
Site is active - 'Latest Website Added' list shows 2026-dated entries
Optional account: Register / 'I forgot my password' widgets exist on the page, but the submit form is reachable without login
Separate 'Submit Article' flow exists for article submissions
preparation: Site URL, title, description, and meta keywords/description (standard fields for this directory family)
Pre-pick the deep category - the tree is long and the form gives no draft saving
workflow: Step 1: select the deep category from the tree
Step 2: fill the listing details (title, URL, description, meta fields, name, email) and submit
Wait for review; verify via 'Latest Links' or the category page
watchFor: No pricing was visible on the step-1 page - sibling directories on the same engine show a paid 'featured' tier on the details step; decline if staying free (catalog note marks this site 'free', unverified for a paid option)
Legacy UX: no drafts, huge inline category list
Site footer is 'Copyright 2009' with statcounter tracking - an old property, but submissions are being listed (2026 entries visible)
Cross-linked with sister directory sites (e.g. qualityinternetdirectory.com in footer) - submit only where relevant
countsAsLive: The link is publicly listed under its category (verify via 'Latest Links' or the category detail page)
unknowns: Whether a paid/featured tier appears on the details step
